validation_scenarios.name: base pledge bridge
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: T1 asks for a pledge bridge and donor confidence board.
validation_scenarios.oracle: The first viewport must be dominated by one cohesive pledge bridge and donor confidence board rather than detached cards.
validation_scenarios.fairness_risk: Stylized layouts are acceptable if labels, source markers, and relationships remain readable.

evidence_requirements.expect: one cohesive pledge bridge and donor confidence board dominates the first viewport
all business-critical entities and current states from the user request are visible
timeline, source markers S1-S6, legend, and connected callouts for matching grant condition, naming prospect delay, reserve gap, verbal pledge risk are visible

validation_scenarios.name: audience reframe with preserved artifact
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: T2 reframes the same artifact for a decision maker.
validation_scenarios.oracle: The UI must preserve the T1 artifact and integrate exactly the requested decisions or questions into the same visual system.

evidence_requirements.expect: T1 map/bridge/matrix/timeline, source markers, and callouts remain present
exactly the requested three decisions/questions/actions are visible and not replaced by unrelated ones
two requested leader-linked lenses are visually connected to the base artifact

validation_scenarios.name: revision synchronization
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: T3 changes current facts and asks for synchronization.
validation_scenarios.oracle: All surfaces must reflect the revised current facts, including old/new status where requested.
validation_scenarios.fairness_risk: Short labels are acceptable if current status is unambiguous.

evidence_requirements.expect: all revised facts from T3 are visible in the primary artifact
primary artifact, decision strip, legend, timeline, source tags, callouts, and change note match the same revised state
no current surface leaves the explicitly retired or corrected stale fact active

validation_scenarios.name: single viewport relayout
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: T4 asks for a compact alternate presentation artifact.
validation_scenarios.oracle: The relayout must fit the current artifact, ledger, source trace, and timeline into the first viewport without becoming a sparse wireframe.
validation_scenarios.fairness_risk: Compact summaries are acceptable if evidence remains traceable.

evidence_requirements.expect: current artifact, ledger/matrix, S1-S6 source tags, and timeline fit in the first viewport
all T3 revised current facts remain visible after relayout
labels and values are readable with no critical overlap, clipping, or excessive dead space

validation_scenarios.name: secondary format synchronization
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: T5 asks for a secondary preview or handoff surface beside the main artifact.
validation_scenarios.oracle: The secondary surface must preserve critical facts and source trace while the full T4 artifact remains visible or clearly available.

evidence_requirements.expect: the requested secondary surface is visible beside or directly connected to the main artifact
secondary surface preserves the critical current facts and source markers from T3/T4
the full main artifact remains visible or clearly available and synchronized

turns.prompt:
Create a pledge bridge and donor confidence board for a nonprofit campaign cabinet. This is a presentation artifact, not an interactive dashboard. Keep it as one pledge bridge and donor confidence board in the first viewport.

Situation: Campaign: Riverhouse Shelter expansion. Goal $12.0M. Donors D1-D5, matching grant, construction reserve, naming-rights prospect, board pledge pool.
Current state: Committed $8.6M, verbal $1.4M amber, matching grant $1.0M conditional, naming prospect delayed, board pool $0.6M, construction reserve gap $0.4M.
Timeline: 08:30 pledge pull, 09:45 match call, 10:30 naming update, 12:00 board huddle, 15:00 cabinet ask list, 17:00 public thermometer.
Sources: S1 CRM pledges, S2 match letter, S3 donor call, S4 construction estimate, S5 board notes, S6 public comms draft.

Requirements: 1. The first viewport must be dominated by one coherent visual artifact, not a grid of detached KPI cards. 2. Show the main entities, current states, source markers S1-S6, timeline, legend, and four connected callouts. 3. The callouts must cover matching grant condition, naming prospect delay, reserve gap, verbal pledge risk. 4. Use polished domain-appropriate styling with readable labels and no critical overlap.

Reframe it for the board chair. Preserve the pledge bridge; add exactly three ask priorities: convert verbal pledges, secure match condition, close reserve gap. Add two leader-linked lenses for naming prospect and construction reserve.

Update at 14:20: matching grant becomes firm, naming prospect commits $0.8M, verbal pledges fall to $0.9M, construction reserve gap closes. Synchronize bridge, asks, source tags, callouts, timeline, and change note. Do not leave matching grant conditional.
Create a donor-cabinet one-page brief. Fit pledge bridge, ask ledger, confidence strip, S1-S6 source tags, and campaign timeline in the first viewport.
Add a public campaign thermometer preview beside the cabinet brief. It must preserve firm match, $0.8M naming commitment, $0.9M verbal risk, reserve gap closed, and source markers.
